complaint: My study camera is still broken even beside the base station after resetting the camera. I carried it into the same room as the base station, plugged it in and held the reset button for 10 seconds as the manual says; the LED goes solid and then dark again. I also tried a different power outlet and a different cable. Everything else in the system works.
usability_reason: The reply is clear and polite, and it gives a concrete next step (escalation with a 24-48 hour contact window). However, actionability is limited because no troubleshooting or diagnostic questions are offered, and the response asserts that environmental/configuration factors were 'ruled out' and that a factory reset, outlet/cable swap, and proximity test were performed—yet the session record shows no questions asked and no actions performed. The customer did report those steps in the complaint, so some support exists, but the response overstates certainty ('all factors ruled out') and claims an escalation/engineering handoff without evidence in the record that it was completed.
